wikitext: {{search|English language [[Pokémon Adventures]] release by [[VIZ Media]]|the longer volumes released in Japan|Pocket Monsters Special Scarlet Violet volume 1}} {{VolumePrevNext |number=1 |series=Pokémon Scarlet & Violet |colorscheme=SV}} {{VolumeInfobox |image=Pokémon Adventures SV VIZ volume 1.png |title=Pokémon Scarlet & Violet volume 1 |number=1 |series=Pokémon Adventures |chapters=[[PASV01]] - [[PASV03]] |chapter=Paldea }} '''Volume 1''' is the first volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version. ==Blurb== Violet Lang and Scarlet Koito attend an academy in the Paldea region and embark on their first big assignments, finding treasures that will help them become amazing Trainers with even more powerful Pokémon! Violet Lang calls himself the Prince of Speed and races across the Paldea region in search of the Herba Mystica that will give his Pokémon ultimate speed. Meanwhile, Scarlet Kioto{{sic}} is a Treasure Hunter in search of the Treasures of Ruin. As the two travel the Paldea region, a new adventure begins!
